statement: An odd state z ≥ (n+1)^2 has odd-step image at least (n+1)^3. Consequently, on OOO at q ≥ 5 the residual is T^3(q) ≥ (q+1)^3, not merely the next-square bound of ooo_suffix_threshold. On a CycleMin whose first odd run has length at least three, the first three-odd residual is at least (n+1)^3. Lean: odd_ge_succ_sq_floorPower_ge_cube, ooo_residual_ge_cube in Preimages.lean; cycleMin_ooo_residual_ge_cube in CycleMinObstruction.lean. The smallest universal local-overshoot A on CycleMin is 2, not 3. Not a halt theorem and not a contained-run prohibition.
